Name: Submerged Crab Pots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod aims to make crab pots less conspicuous when active, by replacing their sprites with a customizable bobber when they contain bait or harvest. It also disables the harvest notification bubble, and optionally removes the water ripple animation.

You can make it not submerged when ready to harvest.

You can tell when a crab pot is harvestable as the bobber will shake and have less of a bob animation.

You can change the size, tint, and opacity of the bobber in the config.

You can change the bobber texture using a Content Patcher [b]Load[/b] action targeting the following path:

[b]aedenthorn.SubmergedCrabPots/bobber


[/b]You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
